reading.title: The Turtle in My Book
reading.purpose: Hear two friends talk about a turtle in a book.
paras: Mina says, "My turtle is clever." Leo asks, "Is he greedy?" Mina says, "No. He is honest and polite."
Leo asks, "Is he gentle with baby birds?" Mina says, "Yes. He is patient too. He waits for them." Leo says, "I want to read it!"

qs.q: Leo asks if the turtle is greedy. What does greedy mean?
choices: Wanting much more than your share.
qs.why: Greedy means wanting much more than your share. Mina says the turtle is not greedy.

qs.q: What does the turtle do for the baby birds?
qs.why: Mina says he is patient and waits for the baby birds.

qs.q: Which word tells that the turtle says what is true?
qs.why: Honest means telling the truth, and Mina says the turtle is honest.
